$schema_note: Aggregate manuscript evidence snapshot — NO animal, jockey, trainer IDs or horse-level rows

within_year_cannon.cohort_selection: documented novel jockey within original horse/marker/distance context, original GPS-positive races>=4
within_year_cannon.measurement: focal first GPS duration minus mean of other GPS-positive horses in same source race (seconds)
within_year_cannon.error_weighting: horse-equal RMSE (mean horse MSE, then square root)
within_year_cannon.prediction: strict prior dated matched-context histories only; n/(n+2) fixed shrinkage
within_year_cannon.interpretation: positive individual-ID-associated source-conditional predictive information, NOT trait causality or external replication

year_forward_doomben.calendar: 2025 fixed prior histories predicting heldout 2026 original source rows
year_forward_doomben.cohort_selection: same original horse numeric ID, 150m first GPS marker and identical official race distance, >=4 GPS-positive race peers
year_forward_doomben.measurement: focal first GPS duration minus mean of other GPS-positive horses in same source race (seconds)
year_forward_doomben.error_weighting: horse-equal RMSE (mean horse MSE, then square root)
year_forward_doomben.prediction: train 2025 only, heldout 2026 only; fixed n/(n+2) shrinkage
year_forward_doomben.interpretation: no source-conditional 2025-history improvement observed; different cohort, source class, dates and site prevent causal time-decay interpretation
